section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the findings of the current study, which examined body appreciation, media influence, and respondent weight status as predictors of consideration of cosmetic surgery among female undergraduates. It highlights body appreciation as the strongest predictor and discusses how media messages contribute to the desire for cosmetic surgery. The section also notes limitations, such as the restricted range of BMI and age in the undergraduate sample, and suggests future research directions including additional psychological variables.
